title: Match the keyboard to the code

do.text: Keep the numeric keypad for a digit code (`inputMode="numeric"`, the default), with `autoComplete="one-time-code"` so phones offer the code they received.

dont.text: Don't ask for digits on a text keyboard: people have to switch keyboards to type them.

do.text: Tell people where the code was sent.

dont.text: Don't ask for a code with no context.
